prepare-job-application.description: Prepare a role-specific application, supporting materials or interview work from current career authority. Preserve sourced resume figures, ATS methods and submission boundaries.

review-deal-economics.description: Review provider economics, risks and commercial conditions, and reconcile figures across a quote, proposal or statement of work. Use current project policy; do not change pricing or infer approval.

build-deck.description: Build or repair a pitch, briefing or scope decision deck around the audience decision, supported claims and explanatory visuals. Preserve editable output and inspect the rendered slides.

review-deliverable.description: Review a finished artifact against its sources, requested task, writing, format and actual completion state. Inspect meaningful content and rendered output; receipts do not replace review.

synthesize-discovery.description: Synthesize supplied interviews and meeting notes into supported findings, or maintain a pursuit discovery ledger and ranked unanswered questions. Preserve exact quotations and distinguish research from proposed actions.

write-feature-spec.description: Write a feature specification, PRD or implementation brief from supplied product evidence. Include relevant user flows, UI states, APIs, data changes and testable acceptance criteria. Use for requested specifications; ordinary bug fixes do not require a separate spec.

scope-project.description: Develop project scope, effort, staffing and timelines, including rough estimates and confirmed quote models. Use supplied exports, rate cards and comparables; use a CRM connector only when configured for the project.

compare-scope-options.description: Compare sourced scope options as a static document or an interactive proposal. Preserve inclusions, exclusions, hours, price, timeline and assumptions from the same versioned input.

manage-service-offering.description: Define, compare and maintain productized service offerings; plan their artifact packages or render internal briefs and external handouts. Use for an offering catalog, not an operational SOP.

manage-salesforce-devops.description: Manage configured Salesforce DevOps Center work items or perform authorized promotion. Select the operation before mutation and retain distinct target, capability, dependency and promotion checks.

maintain-skills-estate.description: Maintain a Skills Estate checkout: author or repair a workflow, validate and package it, install a reviewed release, or replace a skill in another host or account. Select only the requested operation. Also covers plugin grouping and catalog placement, CI or publish failures, stale installs, and why a skill appears in the wrong plugin.

write-statement-of-work.description: Draft or review a statement of work from confirmed scope, commercial data and a selected contract profile. Preserve clause coverage, estimate assumptions and obligations; no default employer terms apply.

design-software-system.description: Explore a service or product design, or write its formal architecture reference. Cover the requirements, components, interfaces, data, security, operations and trade-offs relevant to the requested decision. For a client deal's deliverability or build reference, use solution-brief.

review-writing.description: Review prose, preserve meaning and voice, and learn from writing corrections through a compact private profile. Use for replies, documents, instructions and UI text.
